newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MARKET HEADS LOWER AS CORRECTION BITES.
newsitem.headline: MARKET HEADS LOWER AS CORRECTION BITES.

text.p: Most Estonian shares were down
in late trade on Thursday as gains made in the morning were
corrected after the release of news that the Tallinn city
goverment was mulling the sale of its shares in Tallinna Pank.
The Talse fell by 2.17 percent to close at 272.06 with 81.9
million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
Total market capitalisation was lower at 14.5 billion
kroons compared to Wednesday's 14.8 billion kroons.
"It was a very busy day with the stock moving in both
directions during the day," one trader said.
"The turn in the market happened around 1:30 local time
with news that the Tallinn city government was considering
selling its seven percent stake in Tallinna Pank, and the sell
orders came through for most stocks," he added.
"However, we don't expect the market to fall too much more,
as the general news is still good and we could even expect a
small upward correction on Friday morning," he added.
Hansapank turned over 26.9 million kroons to shed 4.50
kroons to close at 143.50 kroons.
Forekspank was also active with registered trade
of 22.1 million kroons to drop 2.25 kroons to close at 195.00
kroons.
Tallinna Pank cut some of its gains made during the day as
the market went down, but remained 1.50 kroons higher on 77.00
kroons compared to yestrerday's close in trade of 14.9 million
kroons.
Tallinna pank also announced that it will increase its
syndicated loan sum to 50 million kroons from 20 million
kroons.
"We are expecting some more sell orders on most stocks
tomorrow, but Tallinna Pank is still considered a good stock,"
another trader said.
"Tallinna Pank may fall a little more, but it is more
possible that it will rise, if not on Friday, then next week,"
another dealer said.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was seven
million kroons of shares with Rakvere meat plant the
most traded stock.
Rakvere turned over 4.6 million kroons to close higher at
15.75 kroons.
